title: The Disappearance of Hong Kong in Comics, Advertising and Graphic Design

items.abstract: <jats:p>In modern times, advertising is a widely employed marketing strategy primarily aimed at informing consumers about product qualities and promoting them through various means. Advertising is a refined art form, serving as a business strategy to introduce products and attract buyers. Essentially, it involves disseminating information through printed materials or rented advertising spaces to inform and influence potential buyers about a product's qualities. Initially, advertising began with wall writings, handbills, and posters. In the 21st century, the widespread use of digital technology, particularly internet-based technology, has introduced new advertising media. The advent of computer technology has brought significant changes, particularly in the field of graphic design. As a creative medium, graphic design provides advertising with the opportunity to express creativity and enhances the potential for product promotion and aesthetic appeal. To meet consumer needs and preferences, graphic design presents products in a way that facilitates rational purchasing decisions. Traditional materials, combined with models and products, guide the public creatively. Beauty is consistently showcased in various product scenes or TV commercials in advertisements. With graphic design, there have been numerous improvements in visualization, modification, and finalization of advertisements, resulting in high-quality aesthetic presentations. The greatest advantage of graphic design and computer technology in advertising is the enhanced quality and aesthetic presentation.</jats:p>
title: The visual appeal of graphic design in advertising campaigns
